label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise community gathering in the great hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred, possibly marking my forty years as mayor, presented to me as a lighting/readiness check. Builder has installed eight lanterns and innkeeper will escort me inside; their earlier description included a community meeting. Secretary knowingly helps arrange the appointment, though whether the secretary knows any concealed celebratory purpose is uncertain. Bread reportedly carried to the inn may be provisions, but baker's participation is not established.
